one_line: AI spending surges, policy steps tighten data use, safety incidents rise, and a new cybersecurity model launches.

themes.title: AI data‑center spending spikes
themes.text: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle disclosed over $3 trillion in data‑center commitments, while investors reacted to $740 billion in AI capex and Intel’s 28% stock drop.

stories.headline: Big tech firms commit over $3 trillion to AI data‑center spending
Big tech AI capex sparks cash‑flow concerns, stocks tumble
Intel stock falls 28% after weak Q4 outlook, erasing $12B from US government stake

themes.title: Policy moves on AI data use
themes.text: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic adopted a shared robots.txt opt‑out token, India’s MeitY issued a DEPA handbook for trusted data sharing, and bipartisan lawmakers in Arizona opposed new AI data‑center projects.

stories.headline: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic adopt shared robots.txt opt‑out standard
MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training
Bipartisan opposition rises to AI data centers in drought‑stricken Arizona

themes.title: Safety incidents target AI tools
themes.text: OpenAI added stricter weapon‑info limits for teen ChatGPT users, Anthropic’s Claude VS Code extension was backdoored on Cursor, and the Volta‑Autodoxer malware leveraged LLMs to rank victims.

stories.headline: OpenAI tightens weapons‑related information limits for teen ChatGPT users
Anthropic’s Claude VS Code extension backdoored on Cursor, affecting up to 5,000 users
Volta‑Autodoxer malware uses LLMs to rank victims by monetizable assets

themes.title: Mistral releases cybersecurity model
themes.text: Mistral AI launched Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model designed to detect and remediate cybersecurity vulnerabilities, available for independent download.

stories.headline: Mistral AI releases Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter model for cybersecurity
